correctness.rationale: For L>=4 each adjacent successor row contributes exactly three of eight Moore neighbors, producing 1D rule u_i=1 iff d_i=+1 or d_{i-1}=-1. The integer difference identity d_i′=d_i+u_{i+1}−u_i conserves w=sum d_i/3. Positive and negative walls move in opposite directions or vanish; the finite circle relative shift by 2 forces opposite-wall collision on any recurrent mixed-sign orbit, so all recurrent words are shifts of pure-sign words. Tri-nomial word counting yields exact basin B_{L,w}; binary walls modulo 3 and Möbius inversion give recurrent count R_L=6A_L−3 and exact primitive C_{L,p}=6/p∑_{d|p}μ(p/d)A_d. Independent brute transition graph enumeration of all 3^L words through L=9 confirmed every period/winding sector and wall purity; not an all-L proof.
